release_notes: Mobile-first bugfix release porting the tester's addendum IV — all 12 items of that report that exist in this repository (his fork-only theme arc and the user_preferences infrastructure proposal stay out). Mobile panel: Domains, Affiliate Networks and Traffic Sources render as stacked cards below lg instead of nine-column horizontal-scroll tables, with the complex cells (domain status, SSL, actions, source URL) extracted into shared render helpers so the desktop table and the cards cannot drift; modals below 480px are full-height sheets (100dvh + safe-area insets) instead of centred dialogs that hid tall forms' footers below the fold; card titles clamp to two lines instead of truncating to a shared prefix; toolbar controls release their fixed widths so they share rows; the report's pinned name column unpins on phones; the Conversions filter grid stops overflowing; five min-width:auto overflow traps fixed and main uses overflow-x:clip (not hidden, which would break sticky table headers); phone top padding 84px. Backend: the domains endpoint honours its DNS cache TTL — stale rows serve the last known status instantly and refresh after the response via fastcgi_finish_request (inline fallback on non-FPM), instead of serving any cached status forever; the per-lookup debug error_log is gone; the SSL queue selects ssl_source and writes a translated awaiting_dns_for_ssl_switch reason when the Cloudflare auto-detect overrides an explicit Let's Encrypt/custom choice instead of silently clearing the error; login failures return an invalid_credentials code the frontend maps through t(), so an English panel no longer shows Russian prose (the remaining ~54 localised strings migrate incrementally).
